name: another-beginning-materialize-free-regalia
notes: Another Beginning (Akf4kIBApN, GeneratedMacroCode.php cardActivatedAbilities["Akf4kIBApN:0"] / customDQHandlers["Akf4kIBApN:0:CardActivated-1"]): "Materialize a regalia card with memory cost 0 from your material deck." Poisoned Dagger (0D6AfZyKXh, memory cost 0) is seeded in Material. Playing Another Beginning (3 reserve, paid from hand) offers an MZCHOOSE limited to memory-cost-0 regalia in material; choosing myMaterial-0 calls Materialize() directly, bypassing the card's own printed cost. Verified live: Poisoned Dagger lands on the field with ENTERED_THIS_TURN.
